newsitem.title: USA: Parker Hannifin forms three new groups.
newsitem.headline: Parker Hannifin forms three new groups.

text.p: Parker Hannifin Corp said on Wednesday that it formed three new operating groups and expanded the office of the president by adding Lawrence Zeno as a vice president.
Zeno joins Executive Vice President Dennis Sullivan and Duane Collins, the president and chief executive, in the office.
Effective July 1, a new Instrumentation Group will be established separate from Fluid Connectors, and Motion and Control will be divided into two groups, one for hydraulics and one for automation.
That will bring the number of Parker Hannifin groups to eight, which the company said would allow it to better serve its customers as it pushes for global growth.
Parker Hannifin shares were trading up 1-1/4 to 49-5/8 at midday Wednesday.
Parker Hannifin makes motion and control components and systems.
